_note: cine/cine.gd knobs (design/plans/next-lanes.md section 3; event-ready.md row C). Art direction unless a row says where it comes from. Points [x, y, z] in world metres from the patch centre with y over the ground at that x, z; hab points in HAB 1's own space (its door toward -Z, y over the model's lowest point, the deck at 0.40 m). Text is ids only: the words are story and come on 14 Nov (tr() shows the id until a translation names it).

sleep._note: wake_h: a night ends at 06:30 local solar time, 22:00 plus NASA's 8.5 h sleep (factcheck row 208); nap_h: 20 min, between 10 min with no grogginess and NASA's 26 min pilot nap (rows 194, 195). lapse_s = clamp(lapse_per_h x hours, lapse_s). The drone moves from `from` to `to` looking from `at` to `at_to` (smoothstep, no orbit): over HAB 1, high enough that the crater wall leaves the top of the frame to the stars, ending west of the base looking east (bearing 93 deg) so a night's lapse ends on the sun breaking over the rim (bearing 81 deg) behind the base, about a second before the wake (06:08 of the 06:30 end). shadow_range: m the sun's shadows reach for the drone shot (the phone preset's 25 m stops short of HAB 1). room_light: HAB 1's light while the crew sleeps, a share of its own. bench: the donning bench in HAB 1 (forge/hab_interior.py donning(): wall angle 129, 0.4 m deep, seat 0.47 m up) [x, seat y, z, face x, face z]: the hero sits facing into the room. hatch: [x, z] of the hatch's inner face, which the hero turns to after standing up. wake_cam: [from, at] in HAB 1's space, the shot of the hero waking on the bench; wake_hold_s on the bench before standing

trip._note: The rover drives away from a camera left where it stood (cam: m behind, m to its right, m over the ground) for drive_s (from a standstill at the sheet's 1 m/s2 to its 2.8 m/s, about 10 m: small in the frame), the screen goes black, the title holds title_s, then the rover stands at the landmark. title_id: the card's text id; trip_to()'s args fill {sol} and {km} once the story writes them

launch._note: The ascent: the hero boards, an outside shot from out_m away on bearing out_bearing (degrees from north, clockwise) at eye height, the engine kicks dust for ignite_s, the rocket climbs at accel m/s2 for climb_s (tracked by the camera), then the window: a camera beside the rocket (window: m out toward the base, m up) looking back at HAB 1 for window_s, turning toward Earth (the night sky's own planet, DESIGN.night.md celestial) over the last part from turn_at. Earth shows only with the sun down, as on the real Mars. Plume: plume_n dust streams plume_r m out from the pad, thrown at plume_v m/s

shots._note: Tutorial camera shots (cine.gd shot(name)): the camera leaves the play camera, passes each key in turn (s: seconds from the key before) and comes back to the play camera's exact pose over back_s, one cubic through time eased at both ends. eye and look are [ref, [x, y, z]]: ref 'hero' is the hero's feet turned the way the play camera faces (-Z ahead, +Z back toward the lens), and an eye there is pulled in front of anything between it and the head (shot_margin: [m kept clear, head height m]); 'ground' is world metres with y over the ground there; 'world' is world metres as they are; any other ref is a world.json item in its own space (y over its origin). The 'world' point [2053, 518, 2341] is Mount Sharp's summit on the backdrop (models/terrain_backdrop.glb's highest vertex: bearing 139 deg, 3.1 km). fov per key (default the cine fov). music: a cue started with the shot. sunrise (dawn_reveal): the held look clock runs on from the hour it finds so the sun's centre clears the skyline seen from key `key` (the rim at about 1.2 deg on the sun's bearing, 81 deg) `break_s` seconds in, then at h_per_s local hours a real second (the sun climbs about 14.8 deg an hour there, so 1.5 deg a second: it sits about 1.5 deg under the rim as the camera comes round at about 2 s and stands about 6 deg over it at the end); a clock already past the rise is left alone, never turned back. pip_moves: PIP keeps driving (the shot films it rolling up); otherwise it freezes with the hero. Art direction: dawn_reveal looks from west of the base toward the dawn sun (bearing about 80 deg at 06:30) and Mount Sharp, the solar field between them; look_around turns clockwise from the greenhouse past HAB 1, the rover and the solar field to Mount Sharp
